main_argument_chains.claim: the value of a land use project is the original value of the land plus a logistic influence of the project
support_steps: sum the per-unit coefficients over the planned area
let the influence grow toward a carrying capacity
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: read the sign of the capacity as help, harm or no change

main_argument_chains.claim: the profitable range of a project can be read off the net curve
support_steps: subtract the investment and the cost per unit area
add the income per unit area
find where the curve crosses zero and where it peaks
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: implement the project only inside that range

warnings.warning: the closed form divides by the carrying capacity times the decaying exponential plus one, so the influence starts at one over the capacity plus one and only approaches one, whereas the differential equation above it is a logistic that should start near zero and approach the capacity

the desert calibration keeps the printed closed form, so at zero area the value is the coefficient sum plus the capacity over the capacity plus one, and the reported crossing at 2091 square kilometres belongs to a curve that does not solve the logistic equation
